04 · Photo treatment

Improved, not invented.

Nothing here changes what the work is. One consistent grade so twenty-six phone photos read as a single deliberate set, tighter crops so the subject fills the frame, and stray objects removed the way any commercial retoucher would.

Colour grade · magenta shutterply pulled to rust

OriginalGraded

The bright pink shuttering was the loudest colour on the whole site and fought the copper accent. Shifted to rust, it now sits inside the palette.

Cleanup · stray marker line removed

OriginalCleaned

This works for thin, isolated things against an even background. It does not work for large objects — plant and vehicles have to be cropped or shaded out, not erased.

Prototype only. Built from the photos supplied on 14 August 2026. Locations are marked "to confirm" until the owner verifies where each job was — none of these are captioned as Johannesburg suburbs.
